source: Estimates from U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Average Price Data and U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis Regional Price Parities
basis: Estimated metro prices: national BLS average price x BEA all-goods RPP / 100. Not observed metro prices.
coverage_note: BEA publishes no Regional Price Parities for Puerto Rico metros; they have no estimate.
attribution: Sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Average Price Data; U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, Regional Price Parities

bea_rpp_goods.description: BEA Regional Price Parity for all goods (U.S. = 100), for the metro

est_rpp_goods_milk.description: Estimate: national BLS average price for milk, whole (U.S. city average, 2026-10) x BEA all-goods Regional Price Parity for the metro (2024) / 100. BEA publishes no food-specific RPP, so the all-goods RPP is an approximation for grocery prices

est_rpp_goods_eggs.description: Estimate: national BLS average price for eggs, grade a large (U.S. city average, 2026-10) x BEA all-goods Regional Price Parity for the metro (2024) / 100. BEA publishes no food-specific RPP, so the all-goods RPP is an approximation for grocery prices
